reason: My regulars ask me when the next tournament is and I have never had an answer, because I do not know how to run one. For 1,500 with the first month free I will put it in one venue and see if my floor manager can actually work it.
objection: My staff will not learn new software. Setting up a bracket in a minute is your minute, not my counter boy's on a Friday with fifteen people waiting, and if he gives up on it the screen sits blank and I look foolish in front of the regulars I promised.
would_change_my_mind: Someone from your side sets up and runs the first night at one of my venues with my staff watching, so I am buying a working league night and not a login I have to teach.
